checkpoint.initialization: Seven new independent scratch variants per seed; ownEMA only. BASE_REF uses same-seed legally matched fixed final50 as control, never variant initialization.

checkpoint.baseline_provenance: previous full audit VERIFIED: exact role IDs, source RX1/3/4/6/8 x3days, L6300 U56700 hidden V27000,11100optimizer/EMA updates, no target fit or selection

execution.gpu_policy: max3 total experiment processes/GPU including otherowners, >=12000MB free, preserve healthy workloads
execution.stop_rule: Technical input/role/checkpoint mismatch, hidden U truth exposure, target fitting, collision, nonfinite or invalidprediction/scorer closure: stop new dispatch, preserve artifacts and healthy active rows, no autoretry. Scientific source-screen failure: preserve firstseed predictions/scores, do not dispatch seeds02/03; no target feedback. Source-only firstseed thresholds finalLCE<=.5, defaultV mean drop<=1pp andworstRX drop<=2pp vs fixedsame-seed BASE_REF; all8 must pass, no learned classifier probes.
